PHYSICS CHECK  
Governing relation: Compressor power (W_dot) ∝ Head (H) ∝ 1 / (U*A), where U*A is the fouling-degraded heat transfer coefficient.  
DIRECTION-OF-EFFECT: Driving variable = fouling-induced head increase; the mechanism detects rising normalized power (W_dot / Q_cond), which is proportional to head; this raises the failure driver (head), but the warning action reduces damage by enabling cleaning before trip.
